DOCX_EXACT_TEXT_EDIT_V1.claim: Given a .docx package and an exact text-node value that occurs exactly once in word/document.xml, produce a package in which that single text node is replaced and every other package member is byte-identical; when the value occurs zero or several times, fail closed and write nothing.
scope_limits: NO replacement of text spanning several runs or text nodes
NO visual-layout, tracked-changes, comments, headers/footers or numbering guarantees
NO general DOCX editing; one exact text node per call
NO no-op edits: new == old fails closed by design and is outside the input class

SACCR_CREDIT_ADDON_V1.claim: Given a portfolio of linear single-name and index credit derivatives, compute the Basel SA-CCR credit asset-class add-on (CRE52.34, 52.48, 52.50, 52.55-52.72) with an explicit intermediate trace per trade.
scope_limits: NO options or CDO tranche deltas
NO replacement cost, PFE multiplier or whole netting-set EAD
NO rating/entity inference from documents; inputs are already structured
entity with mixed supervisory factor or correlation fails closed (ValueError) by design

rule: Rows are written only by execution_guard/true_capability_harness_v1.py from a receipt. A row is a measurement, not a claim; status MEASURED_SANDBOX never counts; status MEASURED_PUBLIC_RUNNER counts only when the receipt is referee-signed.
